annotations.title: Amen, amen.
annotations.text: [1] What is it (saith S. Augustine vpon this place) when our Lord saith, Amen, amen? He doth much commend and vrge the thing that he so vttereth, doubling it. It is a certaine othe of his, if a man may so say. for Amen in Hebrue signifieth verum, a truth. Yet is it not translated, whereas it might haue been said, verum, verum dico vobis. but neither the [2] Greeke interpreter durst doe it, nor the Latin. the Hebrue word hath remained stil, that so it might be the more esteemed. Tract. 41 in Ioan. By which wordes and the like [3] recorded in other places of this new Testament, the Reader may see great reason, why we also say, Amen, amen, and durst not translate it and such like wordes into our English tongue.
